Strategy: Keep the winning band but strengthen the sliver penalty to thirty-five, testing whether punishing small leftovers harder improves on the current best. It may help by avoiding dead slivers more firmly, but may fail by pushing placements away from tight fits that were actually fine.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (35 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
